properties.name: raf.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the Kafka integration.

properties.name: raf.kafka.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Comma-separated list of Kafka broker addresses, e.g. host1:9092,host2:9092.

properties.name: raf.kafka.producer.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the Kafka producer.

properties.name: raf.kafka.producer.retries
properties.description: Number of retries for failed producer sends.

properties.name: raf.kafka.producer.batch-size
properties.description: Producer batch size in bytes. Larger values improve throughput at the cost of latency.

properties.name: raf.kafka.producer.linger-ms
properties.description: Time in milliseconds the producer will wait before sending a batch. Increasing this value improves batching efficiency.

properties.name: raf.kafka.producer.buffer-memory
properties.description: Total memory in bytes the producer can use to buffer records waiting to be sent.

properties.name: raf.kafka.producer.acks
properties.description: Number of acknowledgments the producer requires the leader to have received before considering a request complete.

properties.name: raf.kafka.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the Kafka consumer.

properties.name: raf.kafka.consumer.auto-offset-reset
properties.description: What to do when there is no initial offset in Kafka or the current offset no longer exists.

properties.name: raf.kafka.consumer.enable-auto-commit
properties.description: Whether the consumer's offset is periodically committed in the background. Set to false for manual commit control.

properties.name: raf.kafka.consumer.max-poll-records
properties.description: Maximum number of records returned in a single poll call.

properties.name: raf.kafka.consumer.concurrency
properties.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads per listener container.

values.description: No acknowledgment. Highest throughput, no durability guarantee.
Leader acknowledgment only. Balanced throughput and durability.
All in-sync replicas must acknowledge. Strongest durability guarantee.
Start consuming from the latest offset (skip historical messages).
Start consuming from the earliest available offset.
Throw an exception if no previous offset is found.
